notes: Arena (formerly LMArena) Text and Text-Coding leaderboards read 2026-10-07 by direct curl; rating, 95% bounds, rank and votes parsed from the embedded RSC rows (413 and 408 model rows). Only catalog models with an unambiguous model key are stored; effort is the model-key suffix (-max, -xhigh, -high) and null where the key has none (qwen3.8-max, glm-5.3-flash, mimo and minimax rows). The text and text-coding rows use different snapshots/comparability groups. Arena votes for GPT-6.1 Sol (3,071 text / 609 coding) and Sonnet 5.5 (3,145 / 779) are still small. Step 5 Preview, Mistral Large 4 and Haiku 5.5 are not on the boards.

claims.statement: Arena Text Coding (2026-10-07): GPT-6 Astra max 1543.2 (rank 7), GPT-6.1 Sol max 1542.2 (rank 8, 609 votes, interval 1518-1566), Opus 5.5 high 1538.5 (rank 12, 1,060 votes), Sonnet 5.5 xhigh 1536.4 (rank 13, 779 votes). Intervals of all four overlap; vote counts for the new models are small. Gemini 4 Argon (high) leads both Arena boards: text 1525.2, coding 1560.2 (1,230 coding votes); it is not a catalog model and is not stored.
